deferred_full_plugin_note: This manifest is intentionally plugin-free. Full QGIS plugin work is deferred until the existing AOI front-door command contract and style bundle are stable, so the bridge stays manifest-only and does not add a second workflow layer.

included_actions.cli_command: PYENV_VERSION=system uv run python scripts/run_aoi_hazard_workflow.py describe-config --site-config <site-config> --format json

expected_inputs.name: site_config
expected_inputs.description: AOI site manifest or candidate site config passed to the existing front door.

expected_outputs.name: describe_config_report
expected_outputs.description: Resolved configuration layers, generated manifest paths, and claim-boundary metadata.

included_actions.claim_boundary: Read-only status and configuration discovery only; no simulation, no package generation, and no operational claim.

included_actions.cli_command: PYENV_VERSION=system uv run python scripts/run_aoi_hazard_workflow.py prepare --site-config <site-config> --format json

expected_inputs.name: site_config
expected_inputs.description: Candidate AOI site config used to bootstrap public geodata and manifest paths.

expected_outputs.name: bootstrap_manifest
expected_outputs.description: Bootstrap AOI manifest written under the workflow output root.

expected_outputs.name: tile_catalog
expected_outputs.description: Bootstrap tile catalog and acquisition manifest surfaces.

included_actions.claim_boundary: Pre-simulation preparation only; no hazard map is produced.

included_actions.cli_command: PYENV_VERSION=system uv run python scripts/run_aoi_hazard_workflow.py candidate-review --site-config <site-config> --candidate-review-output-root <output-root> --format json

expected_inputs.name: site_config
expected_inputs.description: AOI site config used to derive the candidate review overlays.

expected_inputs.name: candidate_review_output_root
expected_inputs.description: Writable review root where the overlay bundle is staged.

expected_outputs.name: candidate_review_overlay_manifest
expected_outputs.description: Overlay manifest and preview bundle for QGIS inspection.

expected_outputs.name: candidate_review_overlay_images
expected_outputs.description: Overlay previews for the candidate release-zone review surface.

included_actions.style_usage: review symbology only; no raster styling claim is introduced here.
included_actions.claim_boundary: Candidate review only; still diagnostic and non-operational.

included_actions.cli_command: PYENV_VERSION=system uv run python scripts/run_aoi_hazard_workflow.py package-map --input-root <hazard-output-root> --output-root <package-root> --overwrite --format json

expected_inputs.name: hazard_output_root
expected_inputs.description: Existing AOI hazard output root produced by the existing front door.

expected_inputs.name: package_output_root
expected_inputs.description: Writable destination for the review bundle.

expected_outputs.name: aoi_hazard_map_package_manifest
expected_outputs.description: Map package manifest with QGIS style references and claim boundaries.

expected_outputs.name: aoi_hazard_map_package_summary
expected_outputs.description: Compact summary of the packaged diagnostic review bundle.

expected_outputs.name: styles_directory
expected_outputs.description: Copied QGIS style bundle and per-layer QML assets.

included_actions.style_usage: copies qgis/styles/ into the package styles/ directory and applies the matching QML references.
included_actions.claim_boundary: Diagnostic QGIS symbology only; not an operational hazard map, risk map, annual-frequency map, or physical-probability product.

included_actions.cli_command: PYENV_VERSION=system uv run python scripts/run_aoi_hazard_workflow.py workflow --site-config <site-config> --format json

expected_inputs.name: site_config
expected_inputs.description: Site config used to resolve the existing front-door status report.

expected_outputs.name: workflow_report
expected_outputs.description: Front-door status, next action, first blocker, and expected-path summary.

included_actions.claim_boundary: Read-only interpretation surface that reports blockers and next steps.

deferred_commands.reason: Execution-oriented smoke runs belong to the CLI front door, not the QGIS Processing bridge.
Prepared-pilot execution is a separate workflow phase and remains outside the manifest-only bridge.
Balfrin submission is explicitly out of scope for a QGIS connector prototype.
Post-submit collection is not part of the front-door review bridge.

style_bundle.claim_boundary: Diagnostic QGIS symbology only; the bundle does not upgrade outputs to operational, annual-frequency, physical-probability, or risk products.
